description: This Java source file defines the DeleteSubject class, which represents a command to delete a Subject from a Policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization and resource path generation.

classes.name: DeleteSubject
classes.description: A command class that deletes a Subject from a Policy entry, including JSON serialization/deserialization, resource path, and equality methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeleteSubject command instance from PolicyId, Label, SubjectId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteSubject command instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the PolicyEntry whose Subject is to be deleted.

methods.name: getSubjectId
methods.description: Returns the SubjectId of the Subject to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the Policy to which the command applies.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteSubject with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object can be equal to this instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on policyId, label, subjectId, and superclass.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on policyId, label, subjectId, and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DeleteSubject instance.
